name: SMTRACK
recent: SMTRACK 因审计师对2026财年财务报表发出无法表示意见（Disclaimer of Opinion），并涉及持续经营重大不确定性，同时公司处于 PN17 与 Rule 8.03A 的月度公告阶段。公司已发布第19届常年股东大会通知，将于2026年12月18日举行。近期董事委员会出现人事变动。
notable: 审计师对2026财年财务报表发出无法表示意见（Disclaimer of Opinion）。
公司发布第19届常年股东大会通知，将于2026年12月18日举行。
Low Henn Kai 与 Mohammed Nasser Bin Yusof 出现董事及委员会职务变动。
risks: 审计师对财务报表发出无法表示意见，并提及持续经营重大不确定性。
公司处于 PN17 与 Rule 8.03A 的月度公告阶段，需进行业务重组或规范化。
新闻提及 RM8.26 million 的 demand loan。

news.title: SMTrack Hit by Audit Disclaimer of Opinion; RM8.26m Demand Loan, GN3 Regularisation Loom
MYMBN Appoints Tan Win Sen as Executive Director
SMTrack Auditors Issue Disclaimer Of Opinion Amid Financial Weakness

recent_en: SMTRACK received a disclaimer of opinion from its auditors on its FY2026 financial statements, with material uncertainty related to going concern, while the company remains in monthly announcements under PN17 and Rule 8.03A. It has issued notice for its 19th AGM to be held on 18 Dec 2026. There were recent changes in board committees.
notable_en: Auditors issued a disclaimer of opinion on the FY2026 financial statements.
The company issued notice for its 19th AGM to be held on 18 Dec 2026.
There were changes in board and committee roles for Low Henn Kai and Mohammed Nasser Bin Yusof.
risks_en: Auditors issued a disclaimer of opinion on the financial statements, citing material uncertainty related to going concern.
The company remains in monthly announcements under PN17 and Rule 8.03A, requiring regularisation or restructuring.
News reports mention an RM8.26 million demand loan.
